title: WPSS/2607/2018 of Sobha Rani AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.2607 of 2018
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.

Mr. Rajendra Arya, Advocate for
the petitioners.
 Mr. M.C. Tiwari, Deputy Advocate
General for the State of
Uttarakhand/respondent nos.1 to 5.
 Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
 Petitioners have approached this
Court seeking the following relief:
ìi. issue a writ, order or direction
 in the nature of certiorari for
 quashing the impugned order
 dated 09.02.2018 passed by
 respondent no.3, Director of
 Education (Basic), Nanoorkhera,
 Dehradun Uttarakhand, in
 relation to the recovery of
 excess payment and fresh
 fixation of the salary to the
 lower pay scale.î
 It is submitted by the learned
counsel for the parties that the
controversy involved in this petition is
squarely covered by the judgment given
by the Coordinate Bench of this Court
on 20.06.2018 in Writ Petition (S/S)
No.562 of 2018. They prayed that
present petition be decided in terms of
the judgment given by the Coordinate
Bench of this Court on 20.06.2018 in
Writ Petition (S/S) No.562 of 2018.

In view of the statement of the
learned counsel for the parties, the writ
petition is disposed of in terms of the
judgment given by the Coordinate
Bench of this Court on 20.06.2018 in
Writ Petition (S/S) No.562 of 2018.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
 03.08.2018
